name: ICT · London Sweep
note: Rule set used by the ict-desk scanner. Parameters mirror PLAYBOOK in films/ict-desk/sim.js. Conventions are common ICT teaching, not a guarantee of edge.

steps.rule: setup must complete inside the killzone
equal highs/lows (tolerance 1.5 pts) mark BSL/SSL pools; previous-day high is the target
wick trades through the pool and the candle closes back inside
within 6 candles a displacement candle (body >= 1.8x avg) closes through the last swing = MSS
3-candle gap left by the displacement overlaps the 62-79% retrace of the leg; limit entry at the overlap midpoint
stop = sweep extreme - 3 pts; risk 0.5% of account; target previous-day high

human_gate: The scanner stages an order ticket. A person must sign. The bot never places the order.
